transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I've been having some trouble at work lately. I'm an auditor, and... I just keep starting these follow-up items after my audits, or sometimes after mentoring sessions. I always mean to finish them right then. But then... I don't know, days go by, and I'll realize the final email or the review note just... never got done. It's becoming a problem.
How much distress or anxiety have you been feeling about not completing these follow-up tasks?

It's... yeah, it's pretty stressful. I don't really like dwelling on it, but... it actually affected a client review recently. I just... I worry people are starting to question if I can even handle the promotion I'm up for. 

And... I guess it's the same at home. My husband has had to take over paying the bills, and some other commitments I agreed to do. He just... he knows he can't count on me to finish them reliably. So... yeah. It bothers me.
Are you having trouble completing tasks only at work or is it also happening with personal projects or chores outside of work?

Well... like I just mentioned, it's at home, too. With the bills and things. I don't really know about personal projects. I haven't... I haven't really kept track of much else beyond what my husband had to take over.
Do you find yourself easily getting distracted while working on tasks?

Yeah... I suppose I do. If I'm trying to review an audit file, it doesn't take much. Just... a Slack ping, or someone talking outside my office. Sometimes even just a random thought about my marathon training... it can pull me completely off track.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things beyond just the tasks you're having trouble completing?
No, not really. Just... mostly just the things I'm falling behind on. I don't really sit around worrying about other stuff.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

I guess... yeah. Um, when I'm in meetings, I'm usually tapping my foot under the table. Or... clicking my pen. I guess I shift around in my chair a lot, too. One of my colleagues actually joked recently that she can hear my leg going. So... I suppose I do.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, my work is pretty methodical, so... I don't really just do things without thinking them through. Not that I've noticed, anyway.
Do you feel overwhelmed or sad when you're not thinking about work or your tasks?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I feel sad. It's really just the stress of the work stuff, like I mentioned. Otherwise, I'm... fine, I guess.
Do you find that you're able to focus and complete tasks when you're working on something that really interests you?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really noticed. Most of my time is just spent on work, so... I don't really have things that I get completely absorbed in. It's all just kind of the same, I guess.
Do you think your difficulty completing tasks is primarily because you're worried about doing them correctly or because you have trouble sustaining focus on the tasks themselves?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't thought about it that much. I just... have a hard time getting through things sometimes. I couldn't really tell you if it's one or the other.
Have you experienced significant difficulties with organization or time management in your daily life?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I get things done eventually. I haven't really noticed any major problems with how I manage my time or anything. It's just... normal, I guess.
Do you often feel down or depressed when you're not thinking about work or tasks?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really... pay much attention to my mood, to be honest. I wouldn't say I feel depressed or anything. I'm just... fine, usually.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and task completion since childhood?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in elementary school... my report cards usually said I was bright, but... I'd lose assignments or rush past small details. I guess I talked out of turn a lot, too, and needed reminders to finish my work. My mom actually still jokes about it... she says I could ace a test but completely forget about the project sitting right in my backpack. So... yeah, it's been a while.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge even when you're not thinking about work or tasks?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't feel anxious or anything. Just... normal.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
Um... no. I don't think so. I usually just... let other people talk, mostly. I wouldn't really say I'm much of a talker.
Do you often feel irritable when you're not able to complete a task?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I wouldn't say irritable. I usually just... move on to something else, I guess.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or treated for ADHD?
Um... no. I haven't. I've never really... talked to a doctor about this before.
Have you noticed any significant improvement in your ability to focus and complete tasks when you're in a highly structured or supervised environment?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really noticed if that makes a difference, to be honest. I just sort of... try to get things done.
Do you have trouble completing tasks or getting distracted when you're by yourself, without any external distractions?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really... paid attention to whether being alone makes a difference. I just... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you have as much trouble completing tasks when you're at home alone as you do when you're at work?
Um... I guess I haven't really compared them. Work and home are just... different. I don't really know if one is worse than the other. I just... try to get through whatever I'm supposed to be doing.
